# zero-server

The whole zero-server core in one crate: every capability behind a feature, all on by default.

[API reference](https://molexxxx.github.io/zero-server/docs/reference/rust/zero_server/index.html) | [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/zero-server) | [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/zero-server) | [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/zero-server/) | [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/ZeroServer)

The full API reference is [on the site](https://molexxxx.github.io/zero-server/docs/reference/rust/zero_server/index.html), and the copy for each published version is on [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/zero-server).

The whole zero-server core in one crate.

Every capability crate is re-exported behind a feature named as the crate
without its `zero-` prefix (the crypto crate as `crypto`, the static file crate
as `files`), all on by default, so an application depends on this crate alone
and compiles only what it turns on. The core types are always present as
`core`.

**Examples**

```rust
assert_eq!(zero_server::core::VERSION, zero_server::VERSION);
```

## const `VERSION`

The version of this crate, as published to crates.io.

```rust
const VERSION: &str
```
